rationale: The session shape shows a failed breakout — price spiked to 143, was aggressively sold back below session VWAP (137.31), and the 5-minute tape is bleeding lower on thin volume, which mildly favors sellers. But the stock sits mid-range (40% of today's range) rather than at a breakdown level, the 25bp spread and illiquid late-day prints (~1-6k shares per 5m bar) impose real execution costs, and shorting a small-float name into the final hour against a +0.96% SPY tape after most of the 143-to-136 move is already spent offers roughly 1:1 risk/reward after costs — not enough edge to commit either direction.
